# Training

B10-05b role cards and the in-shift walkthrough. Draft for product-owner review (b10-design §7.2 item 1). Not delivered at any venue.

Websites, NabaPresence and other external destinations are out of scope (owner scope correction, 11 Nov 2026) and are not taught.

In-app lines: [guidance inventory](guidance.md).

| Module                    | Audience                                           | Practical task                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [T1 Everyone](T1.md)      | All staff                                          | Send one finding on a question from the venue's working list (B10-03 knowledge.working_list).                                                |
| [T2 Kitchen](T2.md)       | Kitchen staff (Back of house)                      | Photograph one dish and label it.                                                                                                            |
| [T3 Bar](T3.md)           | Bar staff                                          | Answer one question the venue's selected set gives bar staff (B10-03 questions.selected_set; the product owner and venue manager choose it). |
| [T4 Service](T4.md)       | Front-of-house staff                               | Report a change to one current answer.                                                                                                       |
| [T5 Venue manager](T5.md) | Manager accounts and staff holding a manager grant | Decide one finding and one recheck.                                                                                                          |
| [T6 Operator](T6.md)      | Admins and the operations owner                    | Walk RB-06 and RB-07 on the owned stack.                                                                                                     |

## Walkthrough

Fifteen minutes (OD-B10-7 default), the same shape for every module:

1. (2 min) Before the session: confirm staff contact is authorised for this venue (X2), choose a quiet moment in the shift, and never use real guests or private information as examples.
2. (3 min) Open the screens the card lists on the trainee's own phone, signed in as themselves. Show where Tips for this screen sits only if the switch is on; otherwise read the card's lines aloud.
3. (7 min) The trainee does the card's practical task themselves. The trainer does not touch the phone. Note where they hesitate, without their name.
4. (2 min) Answer questions from the guides the card links. If a question needs a policy, credit or review answer the guides don't give, say it will be answered by the product owner, and note it.
5. (1 min) Record the session in the venue's onboarding record (training.sessions: module, date, role kind, no names) and each hesitation in the friction log with its classification (B10-05d).

## Friction log (B10-05d)

Classify each hesitation before the wave exits: **release blocker** (stops a task, misleads about state, loses input or discloses data) or **later improvement**. Record the screen, the role kind and the evidence type, never a name.
